name: @vhyxvoid/middleware
description: Zero-config tunnel middleware for Express, Fastify, and Next.js

scripts.build: tsc -b && esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --external:express --external:fastify --external:fastify-plugin --external:better-sqlite3 --allow-overwrite --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild dist/next.js --bundle --platform=node --external:better-sqlite3 --allow-overwrite --outfile=dist/next.js && esbuild dist/fastify.js --bundle --platform=node --external:fastify --external:fastify-plugin --external:better-sqlite3 --allow-overwrite --outfile=dist/fastify.js
